question: _______ became the first Indian to win a race at FIA Motorsport Games in October 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rivaan Dev Preetham**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rivaan Dev Preetham became the first Indian to win a race at the FIA Motorsport Games in October 2024.
 
• He participated in the Karting Sprint Junior category and secured the top position.
 
• The FIA Motorsport Games is an annual multi-disciplinary event that brings together competitors from various motor racing disciplines.
 
• Rivaan's victory is a significant milestone for Indian motorsport on an international platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIA Motorsport Games**

 
 
• The FIA Motorsport Games is organized by the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA), the governing body for world motorsport.
 
• The event features various disciplines including GT, Touring Car, Formula 4, Drifting, Karting, and more.
 
• It aims to foster international competition and camaraderie among drivers from different countries.
 
 
 
• **Karting Sprint Junior**
 
 
• The Karting Sprint Junior category is designed for young drivers, typically aged 12-14 years.
 
• It serves as a stepping stone for aspiring racers to progress to higher levels of motorsport.
 
• Karting is considered the grassroots level of motorsport, providing fundamental driving skills and experience.
 
 
 
• **Indian Motorsport**
 
 
• Indian motorsport has seen significant growth in recent years with increased participation in international events.
 
• Drivers like Narain Karthikeyan and Jehan Daruvala have made notable contributions to putting India on the global motorsport map.
 
• Rivaan Dev Preetham's win at the FIA Motorsport Games highlights the emerging talent in Indian motorsport.
